name: retro-diner-blonde-fashion
image_purpose: Create a vertical fashion portrait in a 1950s-inspired diner setting.

prompt.main_subject: An original adult woman with a slim, naturally curvy figure, platinum-blonde hair in a sleek high ponytail, defined eyes, glossy lips, and realistic skin texture. Do not imitate or depict any real person.
prompt.composition_elements: Full-body vertical portrait, 9:16 framing. The subject sits elegantly in a red vinyl diner booth, body angled slightly, hands resting gracefully, looking toward the camera with a confident editorial expression. White off-shoulder long-sleeve top, high-waisted short black pleated skirt, opaque black tights, black heels, and a small black handbag.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Bright warm indoor lighting mixed with daylight from windows; playful, cinematic, nostalgic atmosphere with clear texture detail.
prompt.technical_specs: Professional DSLR-style photograph, ultra-photorealistic, sharp focus, natural skin texture, raw-style detail, 8K look, vertical 9:16 aspect ratio.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: A professional full-body vertical fashion photograph of an original adult woman with platinum-blonde hair in a sleek high ponytail, seated elegantly in a red vinyl booth inside a bright 1950s-inspired retro diner. She wears a white off-shoulder long-sleeve top, high-waisted short black pleated skirt, opaque black tights, black heels, and holds a small black handbag. Turquoise and red walls, black-and-white checkered floor, pendant lights, and classic diner decor create a playful nostalgic setting. Warm indoor light mixes with daylight from windows. Confident editorial expression, realistic skin texture, sharp focus, ultra-photorealistic DSLR style, 8K look, vertical 9:16.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, real-person likeness, celebrity resemblance, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, duplicate limbs, blurry face, low resolution, watermark, text, logo
